Sapper Moke is a goblin sapper in Act One.
“
Are we gonna blow this place to bits or wot?
„
— Moke

Involvement

Act One

Moke only appears if  Minthara launches a raid on the Emerald Grove. If Minthara learns of the Grove's location such as through the party,  Liam's interrogation, or  Sazza, she gathers a group of goblins to attack the sanctuary. Moke does not appear in the Goblin Camp and is only encountered during this raid. As a sapper, Moke's only purpose is to act as a suicide bomber and blow himself up on an enemy target.

Doesn't affect creatures that have total cover from you.
